This branch investigates neural prediction of optical fields. It is distinct from AIFIELD’s classical simulation functionality and from the proposed analog interpretation processor in ArtiSense.

Conditions belong with the result
Boundary information
Reviewed results include supplied boundary information. This condition must travel with any comparison.
Practical speed
Any speed claim must include preparation, inference and comparison conditions; a practical advantage remains unresolved.

A reviewable experiment would identify its geometry, input and boundary information, reference solution, error measure and full runtime conditions. Both successful and unsuccessful cases matter. The input package does not provide a publishable numerical benchmark or approved experiment figure.

Proposed next investigations concern prediction with less supplied information, behavior across different geometries, larger domains and an end-to-end speed comparison. These are research directions, with no confirmed completion schedule.
